final: SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS account_sum, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3) AS share_of_region_total FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY share_of_region_total DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
